method: Mechanical checks (directory listing, grep, du, gh api, git plumbing) plus the round-2 reconciliations. Measured values are recorded with their date.

rows.detail: Overlapping namespaces publish different figures for the same questions.
rows.evidence: Directory listing at the repository root.

rows.finding: Four different game counts appear for the same 2026 season: 133, 136, 137 and 150.
rows.detail: 150 completed through Week 10 is the official value; 136 is Weeks 1-9; 137 is the feed's Weeks 1-9 plus one Week-10 game; 133 is an arithmetic error (RF-10).

rows.finding: The holdout split names 137 games and leaves 13 in no split.
Round-1 Week-11 venue row says 14 fixtures; the official schedule shows 13.
Round-1 standings capture is one game stale for BAL and LAC.
rows.detail: See RF-12. Superseded by the round-2 read.

rows.finding: Round-1 injury totals in the text disagree with the capture's own totals.
Cincinnati's listed count differs between the brief (4) and the capture (9).

rows.detail: Pre-registration commit history cannot be verified here (RF-18).

rows.finding: Open pull requests at read time: 15.
rows.detail: Four were opened in the 03:13-03:16 UTC window on 2026-11-18 and touch NFL content (RF-19).
A single file carries claims and logs from many sessions. Hard to audit (S-09).
rows.evidence: Measured 2026-11-18 on the claim branch before this round's log entries.

rows.finding: No credential values in the repository.
rows.detail: A scan for ghp_, github_pat_, AKIA and PEM private-key headers matched one file: repo_review/REVIEW-2026-11-06.md, which names the patterns without a value.
rows.evidence: grep over all text files, excluding .git (2026-11-18).

rows.finding: Large raw captures sit in the repository.
rows.detail: data/raw holds 53 MB of earlier-session captures (ESPN and NBA). This namespace uses none of them.

rows.finding: Pages is built from the legacy configuration, branch main, path /.
rows.detail: Read via the GitHub API at the read time: status built.

rows.finding: Round-1 verifier still passes on its own pages.
rows.detail: Ran the round-1 verify.py on the committed tree before this round: PASS.

rows.finding: The results feed cites an official nfl.com URL for each row.
rows.detail: Every row has a source_url field; 32 rows are marked line_by_line and 105 aggregate-only (feed provenance note). 137 of 137 rows carry an nfl.com source_url.

rows.finding: Round-1 'met' verdicts were not all supported by their own artifacts.
rows.detail: Round 2 downgraded 8 rows (see requirements page, 'changed this round').
rows.evidence: Requirements page; each downgrade has its reason.

rows.finding: The build sandbox cannot reach nfl.com directly.
rows.detail: Reads on 2026-11-18 used the page-fetch tool. A direct request returned no response, while github.com answered. CI runners are a separate network path and are not tested here.
rows.evidence: curl -sS --max-time 10 https://www.nfl.com/injuries/ returned HTTP 000 on 2026-11-18; the same call to https://github.com returned 200.

rows.detail: Reviewed: 32 club standings, 14 Week-10 finals, 13 Week-11 fixtures, the Week-10 Lions rows, the round-1 capture, the results feed, the holdout split, the control baseline, the price store, model outputs, removal-of-luck and demotion files. Not reviewed: Week-10 injury chunks 1-7, every other namespace line by line, and non-NFL content.
